title: Hanuman Chalisa
author: Goswami Tulsidas
intro: Forty chaupais in praise of Hanuman by Goswami Tulsidas (16th century), framed by two opening dohas and a closing doha. It is probably the most recited prayer in North India, especially on Tuesdays and Saturdays.
note: The Chalisa is in Awadhi, an old form of Hindi, not Sanskrit, so it is easy to follow. The text follows the common Gita Press reading.
